ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
『就连我们这些知道你们关系好的人，
看着都觉得有点不妙……』

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 上次见到的小阿拉蕾那些朋友，在搞组合啊

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
你肯定会介绍给我们认识
这位超级棒的朋友的，对吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
嗯？
哦哦，《卓柏卡布拉饱和》第一卷呀

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 看你这副样子，估计你把今天的小测验也忘了吧

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 克蕾玛琪丝不是王子人设吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
好像是在铃鸣莱办。
小阿拉蕾会去吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小阿拉蕾也跟小波塔一样喜欢旧版人设吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
就是啊。
不管怎么说……有点……对吧

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 诶～那个还出贴纸了？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我们也很喜欢呢。超可爱的对吧

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 去是去，不过之前电话里说的那事没问题吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小阿拉蕾的话倒是有可能呢～

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 真是的～你们两个也太淡定了吧～

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我看了哦！『前沿文化速递！』

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 算是好的那种换口味？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: <size=150%>『出大事了！』</size>

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我对着屏幕都喊出声了！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小阿拉蕾、小律

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 大家都来了哦

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小阿拉蕾也是哦

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小阿拉蕾——

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 啊！小阿拉蕾

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 是巴鲁君肉包……！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小阿拉蕾！？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_025
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小、小阿拉蕾——

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_026
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 原来是人设啊

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_027
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 啊！是《魔法露露》

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_028
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 这个这个

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_029
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 确实！
